annotations.title: Get the planning controls, lot and development applications for a NSW address in one call.

description: Get the planning controls, lot and development applications for a NSW address in one call. Pass address (e.g. '5A Atkins Rd, Ermington') or lat and lng. Returns the lot and plan, zoning, maximum building height, floor space ratio, minimum lot size, heritage listings and special planning areas, each linked to its planning instrument, plus development applications and CDCs on the site and within radius_m (default 200, max 500), 10 of each, nearest first. Council DCP controls such as setbacks are not included. An unknown or ambiguous address returns an error with suggestions and is not charged. Costs $0.05 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; the first 3 paid-tool calls per day are free for MCP clients. Without x402 support, later calls return the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure; NSW Spatial Services, CC BY 3.0 AU and CC BY 4.0.

address.description: NSW street address with suburb (e.g. 5A Atkins Rd, Ermington)

radius_m.description: Radius for nearby applications in metres (default 200, max 500)
